The dish looks like a paper plate about 20 cm across, so I used that as the scale. The almonds fill a region roughly 11 cm wide. I counted about 40 almonds, and a raw almond weighs about 1.2 g, which gives about 48 g. Almonds are about 6 kcal per gram, so that comes to roughly 290 kcal.

{"kcal": 290, "mass_g": 48}
